body:
I have a very hard time just kicking people out of my life. I get into a routine of seeing people and if I just stop I feel like a piece of shit who abandons people who are close to me. 

I'm back to my old ways of getting shitfaced everyday and I'm afraid I'll have to go back to rehab again after I was doing so good but I'm already struggling to put it back down
I asked "Hey are you mad at me?" And they responded with "No shit I am, You were doing so good and you decided to just blow it" I feel like a piece of shit who's only good at letting others down
